f.title: Describe bias, study size, data transformation, statistical methods and QC in the PASS final report (items 9.6-9.10)
f.statement: The PASS final study report shall describe: 9.6 bias; 9.7 study size, the rationale for any study size calculation and any method for attaining the projected size; 9.8 data transformations, calculations or operations, including how quantitative data were handled and which groupings were chosen and why; 9.9 statistical methods: main summary measures, all statistical methods applied, methods to examine subgroups and interactions, how missing data were addressed, any sensitivity analyses, and any amendment to the protocol data analysis plan with rationale; 9.10 quality control mechanisms to ensure data quality and integrity.

f.title: Report participants, descriptive and outcome data, main results and adverse events in the PASS final report (item 10)
f.statement: The results section of the PASS final study report shall comprise: 10.1 participants (numbers at each stage; for a systematic review or meta-analysis, studies screened, assessed and included with reasons for exclusion); 10.2 descriptive data (participant characteristics, exposures, potential confounders, number with missing data; for reviews, characteristics of each study); 10.3 outcome data; 10.4 main results: unadjusted and, if applicable, confounder-adjusted estimates with their precision, and where relevant relative risks shall be translated into absolute risk for a meaningful time period; 10.5 other analyses; 10.6 adverse events and adverse reactions.

rows.quote: Results: comprising the following subsections: 10.1. Participants: numbers of study subjects at each stage of study. In the case of a systematic review or meta-analysis, number of studies screened, assessed for eligibility and included in the review with reasons for exclusion at each stage. 10.2. Descriptive data: characteristics of study participants, information on exposures and potential confounders and number of participants with missing data. In the case of a systematic review or meta-analysis, characteristics of each study from which data were extracted. 10.3. Outcome data: numbers of study subjects across categories of main outcomes. 10.4. Main results: unadjusted estimates and, if applicable, confounder-adjusted estimates and their precision. Where relevant, estimates of relative risk shall be translated into absolute risk for a meaningful time period. 10.5. Other analyses. 10.6. Adverse events and adverse reactions.

f.title: Discuss key results, limitations, interpretation and generalisability and give references in the PASS final report (items 11-12)
f.statement: The discussion of the PASS final study report shall cover 11.1 key results with reference to study objectives and prior research and, where relevant, impact on the risk-benefit balance; 11.2 limitations, including circumstances affecting data quality or integrity, limitations of approach and methods, sources of potential bias and imprecision, and validation of events, with both the direction and magnitude of potential biases discussed; 11.3 interpretation considering objectives, limitations, multiplicity of analyses, similar studies and other evidence; 11.4 generalisability; and the report shall include (12) references.

rows.quote: Key results: key results with reference to the study objectives, prior research in support of and conflicting with the findings of the completed post-authorisation safety study, and, where relevant, the impact of the results on the risk–benefit balance of the product. 11.2. Limitations: limitations of the study taking into account circumstances that may have affected the quality or integrity of the data, limitations of the study approach and methods used to address them, sources of potential bias and imprecision, and validation of the events. Both the direction and magnitude of potential biases shall be discussed. 11.3.
